sourceBuildID.algorithm: SHA-256 over each sorted src-relative .ts/.css path followed by its raw bytes, matching vite.config.ts

scope: Read-only comparison of all src files with the pinned Git objects, hashes of every src and dist file, comparison of served HTML and every dist JavaScript/CSS file, and confirmation of the source build ID in compiled JavaScript. No source edits, build, preview lifecycle changes, or application commands were performed.
limitations: No independent rebuild was performed. This report confirms the embedded source fingerprint and served bytes; it does not prove a byte-reproducible build or audit asset inputs outside src and the listed build inputs.
manifestAlgorithm: SHA-256 over sorted lines consisting of archive-relative path, NUL, file SHA-256, and LF.
